state_machine_switch_closure_20261109.note: The real switch is 08016fd8 -> 08016fdc: five signed halfword deltas (-198/-182/-160/-138/-132) target 08016e50/e70/e9c/ec8/ed4. All five entries lack Ghidra INSN rows and direct BL callers, so they were decoded from frozen bytes. States 0..3 cover 132 bytes in 90 instructions (88 linear plus a 2-instruction BCS cold tail). State 0 resets on a 0x7e frame flag, state 1 builds a byte-lane mask, state 2 copies payload bytes, states 3 and 4 combine and compare a 16-bit trailer. 0x7d escape, 0x7e delimiter and XOR 0x20 identify PPP/HDLC-style async framing; queue object 0x2000240c has callback +4, 64-byte buffer +8, head +0x48, tail +0x4c and escape flag +0x50. The six earlier literal-load pairs are reclassified as cold-path materializers and ordinary call sites, not switch cases. 0800a578 internal semantics, state-4 downstream code and RAM initializers remain open. Coverage stays 11297/15880 = 71.14%. No firmware execution, device/account/external network access, Ghidra project modification or service restart.

receive_path_closure_20261109.scope: sink 0x0800a578 semantics, command dispatch after state 4, queue field initialisers, residual hole rescan and 0x10f0 block shape
receive_path_closure_20261109.server_58764_observed: Listening on 127.0.0.1:58764 (pid 37904); no login, session creation or account access was performed.
receive_path_closure_20261109.note: The sink 0x0800a578 pushes to one fixed destination address in all three modes; the source pointer advances and the return value is the last word read back, so this is a single-register/FIFO port rather than a buffer copy. Mode 1 takes a byte count and assembles b0<<24|b1<<16|b2<<8|b3, mode 2 takes a byte count and assembles h0<<16|h1, mode 3 takes a word count and moves words verbatim. After state 4 matches the 16-bit trailer, 0x2000230c is read, code = byte & 0x7f is taken and bit 7 selects between 0x08016f06 and 0x0801710c; both paths converge on the five-entry byte table at 0x08017132 (03 0c 14 14 18, deltas 3/12/20/20/24, targets 08017138/0801714a/0801715a/0801715a/08017162), whose base is the return address of bl 0800814c. The queue object 0x2000240c owns eleven fields at +0x8084..+0x80b0, all written once by 0x0801d888 (capacity 256, header limit 4); state 0 re-zeroes four of them per frame. The hole rescan widened the base register to param_1..param_N and required one base expression to join a hole offset to a covered neighbour, which witnesses 027c..02a0 through twelve groups (0x290/0x294/0x298/0x29c) and drops unwitnessed bytes from 43 to 7; 0x27c..0x28f still has no field evidence and 3e01..3e08 has no candidate at all. Coverage stays 11297/15880 = 71.14%. No firmware execution, device/account/external network access, Ghidra project modification or service restart.

disasm_full_image_20261109.scope: decode the frozen sensor image directly from its bytes, and characterise the existing Ghidra export corpus against that decode

disasm_full_image_20261109.server_58764_observed: Listening on 127.0.0.1:58764 (pid 37904); no login, session creation or account access was performed.
disasm_full_image_20261109.note: The image was decoded without Ghidra: 48306 instructions over 103878 bytes (78.16% of the image, 90.26% of the 0x08008000..0x08024000 code region) from 784 entries, with 3455 call edges, no unresolved in-image call target and zero byte overlap between instructions. Three cleanup steps are recorded separately: one self-referential branch at 0x0800d42c was withdrawn as pointer-table data, and a data-shape guard withdrew 380 instructions (806 bytes) sitting inside 46 pointer windows. Every row of the fully agreeing exports (8523) lands on an instruction start with identical bytes, which is the self-check for the decode. Five __gnu_thumb1_case_uqi dispatch sites give 36 targets of which 31 decode; the five-entry table 030c141418 with deltas 3/12/20/20/24 reproduces the earlier annotation-derived result item for item. The three blocks Ghidra had dropped (0x080171a0, 0x08017206, 0x08017668) are all reached, and the third is itself the second dispatch site, which is why losing it also lost six case bodies. Residual checks: the 0x10f0..0x21bc window (4300 bytes) and the 027c..02a4 hole contain no matching immediate or memory displacement in the frozen instruction stream, so those field offsets are reached through computed bases and stay unconfirmed from pixels; 3e01..3e08 yields no candidate; the state-4 dispatch region is decoded as 143 instructions. Coverage is reported under three denominators that must not be conflated: 78.16% whole image, 90.26% code area, 71.14% known blocks. No firmware execution, device/account/external network access, Ghidra project modification or service restart.
